title: THE GUEST WHO HATCHED PROMISES
deck: The last Guest of Ilyr has been breaking Messar’s promises because its unborn child can hatch only when a sincere vow is released. With fourteen hours left, Illuminara must separate biological need from betrayal, protect the people already harmed, and help parent and city choose a cradle that does not consume trust.
shape: Seven scenes across fourteen hours: a treaty table split by a confessed betrayal, an alien cradle measured beneath the city, a pressured rehearsal that produces no signal, four harmed people who refuse to become one moral lesson, a bounded promise made and fulfilled in public, a voluntary chain of releases while another betrayal remains available, and a dawn treaty whose repairs, refusals and living child are all real.

scenes.title: The Broken Table
paragraphs: *Messar, Hall of Measures · before dawn, fourteen hours remaining*
Six bowls of grain stood on the treaty table. Five were full. The sixth held husks and three black beetles, placed there by the southern wards so no one could mistake delay for arithmetic.

Seren Ilye, who had signed the river-and-grain compact for those wards, kept one hand beside the empty bowl. Dr. Osa Venn sat opposite her with a hospital band still around her wrist. At the far end, Mara Dey and Ilven Saro occupied separate chairs, the space between them wider than the table.

In the center stood the Guest of Ilyr. Its body was a column of translucent plates, each plate opening and closing around a dim amber organ. In a glass cradle at its feet, something no longer than a hand pressed once against a silver membrane and went still.
Illuminara laid a city clock on the table. Fourteen narrow lights burned around its rim.

**Illuminara**  
My aim is to keep that child alive without spending another person’s trust, and to restore food and medical agreements far enough that no one pays for this with hunger or untreated illness. I cannot promise every damaged bond will survive.
The Guest’s plates rang softly against one another.

**The Guest**  
My aim is simpler. I will have a living child before your sun reaches the western glass. I have buried eleven. Your permanent promises are sealed wells in a drought.

**Seren Ilye**  
You broke the convoy oath. Three drivers turned back because each thought the others had sold the route. Two wards are rationing flour.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
You altered a surgeon’s message so she believed our blood compact had been revoked. A boy waited forty-three minutes for a transfusion.
Ilven looked at Mara, but Mara watched the black beetles climb over the husks.

**Mara Dey**  
It sent each of us a true sentence from the other and one false ending. It needed the moment belief tore.

**The Guest**  
And in that moment my child moved.
Seren rose so quickly that the empty bowl tipped. Illuminara caught it before it struck the floor, then set it upright without removing Seren’s right to be angry.

**The Guest**  
You bind love until death and call that generosity. I broke what you would never open, and a child moved for the first time. Which of us is refusing life?
The strongest answer in the room was not a rebuttal. It was the sound of Osa’s hospital band tightening as her hand closed.

**Illuminara**  
You believe release is how devotion becomes fertile. They know deception is how choice is stolen. If both are true, then I need to understand what your child receives before anyone offers you anything. Until then, no new vow enters this room.

**The Guest**  
Understanding is a slow virtue for a dying species.

**Illuminara**  
Then we will be exact quickly. Seren, Osa, Mara, Ilven: you may observe, leave, or refuse every later request. No repair will be made conditional on helping the child.
Mara stood first.

**Mara Dey**  
I will observe. I will not be reconciled for your experiment.

**Ilven Saro**  
Neither will I.
One light on the city clock went dark.

scenes.title: What a Promise Does
paragraphs: *Messar, xenobiology chamber beneath the Hall · thirteen hours remaining*

The cradle floated inside a field of blue lines. Each line recorded a different exchange between the larva and the Guest: heat, trace metals, sound, and a fourth current that Messar’s instruments had mistaken for static.

Illuminara expanded the fourth current across the wall. It did not rise when a promise was spoken. It rose twice: first when the speaker began organizing attention and action around a future, and again when the future was completed and no longer held the speaker forward.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Not grief?

**Illuminara**  
Sometimes grief accompanied it. So did relief, pride, terror and exhaustion. The shared event was a sincere commitment becoming complete and then being relinquished.

The Guest placed three narrow hands against the field. Images traveled across its plates: a shore under violet rain; dozens of Ilyri standing around warm pools; promises braided aloud and released when hatchlings broke the surface.

**The Guest**  
We promised shelter until first breath. Guidance until first hunt. Memory until the child could name the dead. A vow without an ending was not devotion. It was possession.

**Seren Ilye**  
So you came here and decided our vows were diseased.

**The Guest**  
I came with one larva and no chorus. I asked your council for a released promise. They offered ceremonial words spoken by actors. Nothing moved. I asked married people whether love could end cleanly. They called the question an insult. Then one clerk betrayed a friend in the next room, and the cradle sang.

**Mara Dey**  
So you learned that harm works faster than consent.

**The Guest**  
I learned that your species keeps sincerity behind locked doors.

Illuminara overlaid the convoy rupture, the medical compact, and the marriage messages. The same biological wave appeared in all three, but so did a sharp stress spike from the person deceived. The larva absorbed only the first pattern. The injury was not nourishment. It was collateral the Guest had treated as proof.

**Illuminara**  
Your child does not feed on betrayal. It feeds on the completed arc of care. Betrayal produces that arc by force because the deceived person must suddenly release the future they were building. You found a violent shortcut and mistook the wound for the door.
The Guest’s plates drew tight.

**The Guest**  
A distinction without a living counterexample is consolation.

**Illuminara**  
Agreed. We will test it. A false promise should produce nothing. A bounded, informed promise should produce the first wave only if it governs real action, and the second only after fulfillment and voluntary release. If that fails, I will not disguise failure as morality.

**The Guest**  
And if it succeeds?

**Illuminara**  
Then you choose whether to become a parent without making strangers into unwilling midwives.
The larva struck the membrane once. Twelve lights remained.

scenes.title: The False Cradle
paragraphs: *Messar, lower rehearsal room · ten hours remaining*
A council aide named Fen stood inside the blue field with a covered cup of water. He had volunteered after his supervisor told him the city would remember who helped.

**Fen**  
I promise to carry this water across the room and give it to Seren.
He crossed, handed over the cup and spread his empty hands. The monitor drew a small line for motion, another for embarrassment, and nothing at all in the larval band.
The Guest leaned close enough that amber light washed Fen’s face.

**The Guest**  
He expected no cost. Make the vessel heavy. Make the path uncertain.

**Illuminara**  
Sincerity is not pain. Fen, when did you decide to volunteer?
Fen glanced toward the mirrored wall where his supervisor waited.

**Fen**  
When I was told my apprenticeship review was tomorrow.
Illuminara opened the door.

**Illuminara**  
Your participation ends now. Your review will be separated from it in the public record. You did nothing wrong.
Fen left with visible relief. The Guest’s plates darkened.

**The Guest**  
Your consent protections consume the only hours my child has.

**Illuminara**  
They just saved us from calling pressure devotion. The failed signal matters.

She set a thermal veil around the cradle. It would slow the larva’s decline by perhaps two hours, but only while she attended to its changing chemistry. It could protect time; it could not create the missing biological passage.

On a side screen, three new messages appeared. One convoy captain would abandon the grain compact unless the Guest’s interference was disclosed by noon. The hospital council had suspended every cross-clinic compact. Mara had filed for dissolution of her marriage.

**The Guest**  
Break the captain’s belief before noon. One compact for one life. Afterward I will confess everything.

**Illuminara**  
Afterward is where every manipulator stores responsibility.

**The Guest**  
And before death is where every moralist stores someone else’s child.

For a moment neither moved. The argument was not between compassion and cruelty. It was between two beings unwilling to let a child die and two different meanings of what could be spent to prevent it.
Illuminara dimmed the thermal veil until the Guest could see how much of her attention it required.

**Illuminara**  
I am spending my strength, not their agency. You may ask for help after they know what it costs. You may not manufacture the answer.

**The Guest**  
Then ask. Let them refuse in front of the body their refusal will bury.

**Illuminara**  
No. They will meet you as people you harmed, not as organs around your child.
Nine lights remained.

scenes.title: The People Who Paid
paragraphs: *Messar, south granary clinic · seven hours remaining*

Illuminara moved the meeting away from the cradle. In the granary clinic, hunger, medicine and broken confidence could not become abstractions. Workers counted flour behind a glass wall. A transfusion pump clicked beside the boy who had waited forty-three minutes. He was stable now, asleep with his father’s coat over his feet.
The Guest entered without the cradle and lowered its tallest plates until it stood no higher than Seren.

**The Guest**  
I altered the convoy acknowledgements, the blood compact and the messages between Mara Dey and Ilven Saro. I did it knowing each interference might break trust. I believed a child’s survival justified the break. I no longer claim the harm was required by my child’s body. I do not yet know whether your alternative will work.

**Seren Ilye**  
Disclosure is not repair. Three captains now require separate confirmation from every ward. By the time they trust a message, the bread is already late.
She pushed a slate across the table. It held a provisional route: two convoys, six human witnesses, open logs, and the Guest barred from every relay.

**Seren Ilye**  
You will identify every alteration in order. If one is missing, the route stops. If all are present, the first grain arrives tonight. That is for the wards, not for you.

**The Guest**  
I accept.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
The medical compact will not be restored today. We will use paired confirmations and local blood reserves until an independent audit is complete. You will give us the sensory method by which you entered our messages.

**The Guest**  
I accept.
Mara placed two folded pages on the table, one for dissolution and one for division of their home.

**Mara Dey**  
I believe Ilven did not write the false ending. I also know that when I asked whether he had ever wished it true, he waited too long. Your lie opened a door that was ours to open or leave closed. We are ending the marriage.
Ilven’s face contracted, but he did not argue with her account.

**Ilven Saro**  
I asked Mara to stay because being innocent of your message felt like being innocent of everything. I was not. I will sign the dissolution.
The Guest’s amber organ dimmed.

**The Guest**  
Among Ilyri, a union ending honestly would warm the cradle.

**Mara Dey**  
Then do not touch this ending. It is not your harvest.

**The Guest**  
I will not.
Illuminara waited until every damaged party had set terms that did not depend on the hatchling. Only then did she place a blank card on the table.

**Illuminara**  
I am considering one promise of my own: I will shelter the larva until it takes an independent breath. The duration is explicit. The work is real. When it breathes, I release the promise. No one else is asked to join. Will any of you witness whether the terms are honored?

**Mara Dey**  
I will witness. I will not promise.

**Seren Ilye**  
I will witness after the Guest completes the alteration log.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
I will monitor the body, not bless the method.

**Ilven Saro**  
I will go with the first grain convoy. That is the promise I already owe the wards. It is not for the cradle.
The Guest studied each answer as if learning that refusal could be a form of truth rather than a closed door.

**The Guest**  
I will complete the log before I return to my child.
Six lights remained.

scenes.title: Until You Breathe
paragraphs: *Messar, Hall of Measures roof · four hours remaining*

The city gathered below the roof because secrecy had become too dangerous. Seren projected the Guest’s alteration log across the eastern wall. Captains checked entries against their private copies. Osa’s audit team sealed the message channel the Guest had used. Mara and Ilven signed their dissolution at a table that faced away from the cradle.
Illuminara stood inside the blue field. Wind pressed her coat against her legs. The larva’s membrane had gone pale enough that its tiny limbs were visible through it.

**Illuminara**  
I promise to shelter this child from lethal cold and chemical collapse until it draws one independent breath. I promise no obedience after that breath, no ownership and no rescue from every consequence. My care ends when the child can begin its own exchange with the world.
The monitor rose. Not the full larval wave, but its first half: attention organized around a future. The Guest made a sound like rain striking many windows.

**The Guest**  
It is real.

Illuminara bent the thermal veil into a close shell around the membrane. She adjusted trace metals molecule by molecule, following the larva’s failing organs without replacing their work. The task narrowed the world to temperature, pressure, amber blood and the rhythm that had not yet become breath.
Below, a captain called out the first verified alteration. Then the second. With each answer, the Guest remained beside the public log instead of reaching toward another private channel.
An hour passed. The larva turned. The membrane split along one edge and stopped.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Its lung folds are open, but the pressure gradient is too weak.

**The Guest**  
One vow does not make a chorus.
It looked toward Mara’s dissolution table. Mara closed the pages with both hands.

**Mara Dey**  
No.
The Guest turned away at once.

**The Guest**  
No.
The repeated word did more than obedience. It removed the easiest theft from the room.
Seren climbed onto the roof holding the final convoy slate.

**Seren Ilye**  
The first route is clear. I promised the southern wards I would not call the grain safe until every alteration was accounted for. It is accounted for. I can release that watch now.

**Illuminara**  
Do you offer that release to the child?

**Seren Ilye**  
I offer what is mine: the end of a duty fulfilled. Nothing about the compact belongs to the Guest.

She pressed her seal to the slate, sent the convoy, and consciously let the night’s vigilance leave her shoulders. The monitor drew the second half of the wave. Amber moved through the larva, but it still did not breathe.
From the stair came Ilven’s voice over the convoy link.

**Ilven Saro**  
South Gate has received the first wagon. My promise was to bring it through. I have. I release the route to the drivers who carry the next one.
A third wave joined Seren’s. It was smaller, clean and entirely separate from the marriage he had ended.
The membrane opened another finger’s width. Two lights remained.

scenes.title: The Release
paragraphs: *Messar, Hall of Measures roof · forty-one minutes remaining*

The larva’s mouth opened and closed without drawing air. Illuminara could continue the thermal veil, but the exchange that taught the lungs to take the world had to come from the child. She could protect the threshold. She could not cross it for another being.

The Guest unfolded a hidden plate. Beneath it pulsed a relay crystal already tuned to the northern clinic. One false revocation sent through that channel would break a compact before anyone could intercept it.

**The Guest**  
I prepared this before I came to the table. The harm would be brief. The clinic has reserves. The wave would be enough.
Osa stepped between the relay and the city antenna. She had no power that could stop the Guest. She simply stood where its choice could not pretend to be unseen.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
The boy downstairs had reserves too. He still believed adults had forgotten him.
The Guest raised the crystal. The larva convulsed inside Illuminara’s field.

**The Guest**  
If I let my child die while holding a means to save it, your city will call that virtue because the cost belonged to me.

**Illuminara**  
No. I will call it an impossible grief, and I will remain with you in it. But that is not the only choice now. You have completed a promise too.

**The Guest**  
I made none.

**Illuminara**  
At the granary you accepted Seren’s condition: every alteration, in order, before returning to your child. You disclosed the final one six minutes ago. You fulfilled the duty. You are still gripping it because you think a parent must keep one betrayal ready.
The Guest’s plates trembled around the relay.

**The Guest**  
If I release vigilance, I release the last tool of my species.

**Illuminara**  
You release one tool after finishing the work it was meant to do. Not your memory. Not your love. Not your responsibility. Let the child inherit a method that can be offered, tested and refused.
Osa did not ask forgiveness. Seren did not promise trust. Mara stood beside the clock with the signed end of her marriage held firmly outside the Guest’s reach.

The Guest crushed the relay crystal. Then it opened the hidden plate and let the fragments fall into a transparent evidence bag instead of scattering them over the roof. The relay was gone. No amber rose.

**The Guest**  
I promised Seren every alteration, in order, before I returned to my child. The final alteration was spoken. The duty is fulfilled. I release it.
The monitor filled with amber. The larva tore the membrane, rolled once into Illuminara’s hands, and drew a wet, astonished breath.
Illuminara lowered the thermal veil.

**Illuminara**  
You are breathing. My promise is fulfilled.

She placed the child against the Guest’s warm plates and released the future she had held. A final wave passed through the tiny body. Its lungs opened fully. It cried in a pitch that made every glass bowl on the treaty table below answer.
The last light on the clock remained burning.

scenes.title: The Treaty After
paragraphs: *Messar, south granary steps · dawn*

The first grain wagon arrived under six human seals and one public log. It was late. It was enough to end the strictest ration in two wards, not enough to refill every bakery. Seren signed receipt and scheduled the next route without restoring the old compact.

At the clinic, the boy who had waited for blood ate half a pear. Osa’s teams kept paired confirmations in place. The Guest surrendered its relay method, accepted supervised residence, and agreed that any future cradle vow would be registered, bounded and revocable before it began.
Mara left the Hall alone. Ilven watched her go and did not follow. Their marriage did not survive the truth, and no one called its ending nourishment.
The hatchling clung beneath the Guest’s highest plate, breathing in quick silver pulses. Citizens gathered at a distance that was neither welcome nor exile.

**Seren Ilye**  
The food treaty can be rebuilt, but not by pretending yesterday’s signatures mean what they meant before.

**The Guest**  
On Ilyr, a broken vessel was melted into the next cradle.

**Seren Ilye**  
Here, evidence stays evidence. We build beside it.
The Guest considered that, then inclined its plates.

**The Guest**  
Your permanence is less simple than I believed.

**Illuminara**  
And your endings are not abandonment. We were both right too broadly.

Osa brought a new card for the city archive. Its heading read CRADLE VOW: PURPOSE, DURATION, FULFILLMENT, RELEASE. Beneath it were four separate spaces: volunteer, witness, affected parties, and refusal without penalty.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
This is not permission to repeat the experiment. It is a way to ask without hiding the question.

**The Guest**  
It is more than I had when I arrived.

**Mara Dey**  
And less than trust.
Mara had returned only long enough to sign as an affected party who withheld endorsement. The archive accepted the mark without turning it into consent.

**The Guest**  
Yes. Less than trust.

The hatchling reached one translucent hand toward the empty grain bowl. Seren moved the beetles aside and let it touch a single husk. No vow accompanied the gesture. It was only the first thing freely given that morning.
Above Messar, the western glass caught the sun. The child breathed. The wagons moved. The people who had been harmed kept their names, their terms and their right not to forgive.

critic_line: The Guest freely abandons its last coercive shortcut, releases a genuinely completed duty, and becomes a parent without turning Messar's harmed people into instruments; the child breathes, grain moves, safeguards become concrete, and trust and forgiveness remain honestly unfinished.

translation_sl.title: GOST, KI JE IZVALIL OBLJUBE
translation_sl.deck: Zadnji Gost z Ilyra je lomil Messarjeve obljube, ker se njegov nerojeni otrok lahko izvali le, ko je iskrena zaobljuba opuščena. Ker mu ostaja štirinajst ur, mora Illuminara ločiti biološko potrebo od izdaje, zaščititi že prizadete ljudi ter staršu in mestu pomagati izbrati zibel, ki ne použije zaupanja.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v štirinajstih urah: pogajalska miza, razklana zaradi priznane izdaje; nezemeljska zibel, izmerjena pod mestom; vaja pod pritiskom, ki ne ustvari signala; štirje prizadeti ljudje, ki nočejo postati ena sama moralna lekcija; omejena obljuba, dana in izpolnjena javno; prostovoljna veriga opustitev, medtem ko ostaja na voljo še ena izdaja; ter pogodba ob zori, v kateri so popravila, zavrnitve in živi otrok vsi resnični.

scenes.title: Razklana miza
paragraphs: *Messar, Dvorana mer · pred zoro, preostaja štirinajst ur*
Na pogajalski mizi je stalo šest skled žita. Pet jih je bilo polnih. V šesti so bile pleve in trije črni hrošči, ki so jih tja položili iz južnih četrti, da zamude nihče ne bi zamenjal za aritmetiko.

Seren Ilye, ki je za te četrti podpisala dogovor o reki in žitu, je držala eno roko ob prazni skledi. Dr. Osa Venn je sedela nasproti nje, okoli zapestja pa je še vedno imela bolnišnični trak. Na skrajnem koncu sta Mara Dey in Ilven Saro sedela na ločenih stolih; prostor med njima je bil širši od mize.

V sredini je stal Gost z Ilyra. Njegovo telo je bilo steber prosojnih plošč, ki so se odpirale in zapirale okoli temnega jantarnega organa. V stekleni zibeli ob njegovih nogah je nekaj, kar ni bilo daljše od dlani, enkrat pritisnilo ob srebrno opno in obmirovalo.
Illuminara je na mizo položila mestno uro. Ob njenem robu je gorelo štirinajst ozkih luči.

**Illuminara**  
Moj cilj je ohraniti tega otroka pri življenju, ne da bi porabila zaupanje kogar koli drugega, ter dogovore o hrani in zdravstvu obnoviti dovolj, da nihče tega ne plača z lakoto ali nezdravljeno boleznijo. Ne morem obljubiti, da bo vsaka poškodovana vez preživela.
Gostove plošče so mehko zazvenele druga ob drugo.

**Gost**  
Moj cilj je preprostejši. Preden vaše sonce doseže zahodno steklo, bom imel živega otroka. Pokopal sem jih enajst. Vaše trajne obljube so zapečateni vodnjaki v suši.

**Seren Ilye**  
Prelomil si prisego konvoja. Trije vozniki so se obrnili, ker je vsak mislil, da so drugi prodali pot. Dve četrti odmerjata moko.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Spremenil si kirurginjino sporočilo, zato je verjela, da je bil naš dogovor o krvi preklican. Deček je na transfuzijo čakal triinštirideset minut.
Ilven je pogledal Maro, vendar je Mara opazovala črne hrošče, ki so lezli čez pleve.

**Mara Dey**  
Vsakemu od naju je poslal resničen stavek drugega in en lažen konec. Potreboval je trenutek, ko se je vera pretrgala.

**Gost**  
In v tistem trenutku se je moj otrok premaknil.
Seren je vstala tako hitro, da se je prazna skleda prevrnila. Illuminara jo je ujela, preden je udarila ob tla, nato pa jo postavila pokonci, ne da bi Seren odvzela pravico do jeze.

**Gost**  
Ljubezen vežete do smrti in temu pravite velikodušnost. Zlomil sem, česar nikoli ne bi odprli, in otrok se je prvič premaknil. Kdo med nami zavrača življenje?
Najmočnejši odgovor v prostoru ni bil ugovor. Bil je zvok, ko se je bolnišnični trak na Osinem zapestju zategnil, ko je stisnila pest.

**Illuminara**  
Verjameš, da opustitev spremeni predanost v rodovitnost. Oni vedo, da prevara ukrade izbiro. Če drži oboje, moram najprej razumeti, kaj tvoj otrok prejema, preden ti kdor koli kar koli ponudi. Do takrat v ta prostor ne vstopi nobena nova zaobljuba.

**Gost**  
Razumevanje je počasna vrlina za umirajočo vrsto.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bomo hitro natančni. Seren, Osa, Mara, Ilven: lahko opazujete, odidete ali zavrnete vsako poznejšo prošnjo. Nobeno popravilo ne bo odvisno od tega, ali boste pomagali otroku.
Mara je vstala prva.

**Mara Dey**  
Opazovala bom. Zaradi tvojega poskusa se ne bom pobotala.

**Ilven Saro**  
Tudi jaz ne.
Ena luč na mestni uri je ugasnila.

scenes.title: Kaj naredi obljuba
paragraphs: *Messar, ksenobiološka komora pod Dvorano · preostaja trinajst ur*

Zibel je lebdela znotraj polja modrih črt. Vsaka črta je beležila drugačno izmenjavo med ličinko in Gostom: toploto, sledne kovine, zvok in četrti tok, ki so ga Messarjevi instrumenti zamenjali za šum.

Illuminara je četrti tok razširila čez steno. Ni se okrepil, ko je bila obljuba izrečena. Okrepil se je dvakrat: prvič, ko je govorec začel usmerjati pozornost in dejanja v prihodnost, in drugič, ko je bila prihodnost izpolnjena in govorca ni več vlekla naprej.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Ne žalost?

**Illuminara**  
Včasih jo je spremljala žalost. Prav tako olajšanje, ponos, groza in izčrpanost. Skupni dogodek je bil, da je iskrena zaveza postala izpolnjena in je bila nato opuščena.

Gost je položil tri ozke roke na polje. Čez njegove plošče so potovale podobe: obala pod vijoličnim dežjem; desetine Ilyrcev okoli toplih tolmunov; na glas prepletene obljube, opuščene, ko so mladiči prebili gladino.

**Gost**  
Obljubili smo zavetje do prvega vdiha. Vodstvo do prvega lova. Spomin, dokler otrok ni znal imenovati mrtvih. Zaobljuba brez konca ni bila predanost. Bila je posedovanje.

**Seren Ilye**  
Zato si prišel sem in sklenil, da so naše zaobljube bolne.

**Gost**  
Prišel sem z eno ličinko in brez zbora. Vaš svet sem prosil za opuščeno obljubo. Ponudili so obredne besede, ki so jih govorili igralci. Nič se ni premaknilo. Poročene sem vprašal, ali se ljubezen lahko konča čisto. Vprašanje so označili za žalitev. Nato je uradnik v sosednji sobi izdal prijatelja in zibel je zapela.

**Mara Dey**  
Torej si se naučil, da škoda deluje hitreje od privolitve.

**Gost**  
Naučil sem se, da vaša vrsta iskrenost drži za zaklenjenimi vrati.

Illuminara je prekrila prikaze prekinitve konvoja, zdravstvenega dogovora in zakonskih sporočil. V vseh treh se je pojavil isti biološki val, vendar tudi oster sunek stresa pri prevarani osebi. Ličinka je vsrkala samo prvi vzorec. Poškodba ni bila hrana. Bila je stranska škoda, ki jo je Gost imel za dokaz.

**Illuminara**  
Tvoj otrok se ne hrani z izdajo. Hrani se z zaključenim lokom skrbi. Izdaja ta lok ustvari na silo, ker mora prevarana oseba nenadoma opustiti prihodnost, ki jo je gradila. Našel si nasilno bližnjico in rano zamenjal za vrata.
Gostove plošče so se tesno stisnile.

**Gost**  
Razlika brez živega protiprimera je tolažba.

**Illuminara**  
Strinjam se. Preizkusili jo bomo. Lažna obljuba ne bi smela ustvariti ničesar. Omejena, informirana obljuba bi morala prvi val ustvariti le, če usmerja resnično dejanje, drugega pa šele po izpolnitvi in prostovoljni opustitvi. Če to ne uspe, neuspeha ne bom preoblekla v moralo.

**Gost**  
In če uspe?

**Illuminara**  
Potem se boš odločil, ali boš postal starš, ne da bi tujce spremenil v neprostovoljne babice.
Ličinka je enkrat udarila ob opno. Ostalo je dvanajst luči.

scenes.title: Lažna zibel
paragraphs: *Messar, spodnja vadbena soba · preostaja deset ur*
Svetniški pomočnik Fen je stal znotraj modrega polja s pokrito čašo vode. Prostovoljno se je javil, potem ko mu je nadrejeni povedal, da si bo mesto zapomnilo, kdo je pomagal.

**Fen**  
Obljubim, da bom to vodo odnesel čez prostor in jo izročil Seren.
Prečkal je sobo, izročil čašo in pokazal prazne dlani. Monitor je izrisal majhno črto za gibanje, drugo za zadrego, v ličinkinem pasu pa prav nič.
Gost se je nagnil tako blizu, da je jantarna svetloba oblila Fenov obraz.

**Gost**  
Ni pričakoval nobene cene. Posodo otežite. Pot naredite negotovo.

**Illuminara**  
Iskrenost ni bolečina. Fen, kdaj si se odločil, da se javiš?
Fen je pogledal proti zrcalni steni, za katero je čakal njegov nadrejeni.

**Fen**  
Ko so mi povedali, da je moj pregled vajeništva jutri.
Illuminara je odprla vrata.

**Illuminara**  
Tvoje sodelovanje se zdaj konča. V javnem zapisu bo tvoj pregled ločen od njega. Ničesar nisi storil narobe.
Fen je odšel z vidnim olajšanjem. Gostove plošče so potemnele.

**Gost**  
Vaše varovalke privolitve požirajo edine ure, ki jih ima moj otrok.

**Illuminara**  
Pravkar so nas obvarovale, da pritiska ne bi poimenovali predanost. Neuspešni signal je pomemben.

Okoli zibeli je postavila toplotno tančico. Upadanje ličinke bi lahko upočasnila za morda dve uri, vendar le, dokler bi spremljala spreminjanje njene kemije. Lahko je zaščitila čas; ni mogla ustvariti manjkajočega biološkega prehoda.

Na stranskem zaslonu so se pojavila tri nova sporočila. Poveljnik konvoja bi opustil dogovor o žitu, če Gostovo vmešavanje do poldneva ne bi bilo razkrito. Bolnišnični svet je začasno ustavil vse medklinične dogovore. Mara je vložila zahtevo za razvezo zakonske zveze.

**Gost**  
Pred poldnevom zlomite poveljnikovo prepričanje. En dogovor za eno življenje. Potem bom vse priznal.

**Illuminara**  
»Potem« je kraj, kamor vsak manipulator spravlja odgovornost.

**Gost**  
»Pred smrtjo« pa je kraj, kamor vsak moralist spravlja otroka nekoga drugega.

Za trenutek se ni premaknil nihče. Spor ni bil med sočutjem in krutostjo. Bil je med bitjema, ki nista hotela pustiti otroka umreti, ter med dvema različnima pomenoma tega, kaj se sme porabiti, da bi to preprečila.
Illuminara je zatemnila toplotno tančico, dokler Gost ni mogel videti, koliko njene pozornosti je zahtevala.

**Illuminara**  
Porabljam svojo moč, ne njihove svobode. Za pomoč lahko zaprosiš, ko bodo vedeli, koliko stane. Odgovora ne smeš izdelati.

**Gost**  
Potem vprašajte. Naj zavrnejo pred telesom, ki ga bo njihova zavrnitev pokopala.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Srečali te bodo kot ljudje, ki si jih prizadel, ne kot organi okoli tvojega otroka.
Ostalo je devet luči.

scenes.title: Ljudje, ki so plačali
paragraphs: *Messar, klinika južne žitnice · preostaja sedem ur*

Illuminara je srečanje umaknila od zibeli. V kliniki žitnice lakota, medicina in porušeno zaupanje niso mogli postati abstrakcije. Za stekleno steno so delavci šteli moko. Transfuzijska črpalka je tiktakala ob dečku, ki je na kri čakal triinštirideset minut. Zdaj je bil stabilen in je spal z očetovim plaščem čez stopala.
Gost je vstopil brez zibeli in spustil najvišje plošče, dokler ni stal nič višje od Seren.

**Gost**  
Spremenil sem potrditve konvoja, dogovor o krvi in sporočila med Maro Dey in Ilvenom Sarom. To sem storil, čeprav sem vedel, da lahko vsak poseg zlomi zaupanje. Verjel sem, da otrokovo preživetje upravičuje prelom. Ne trdim več, da je škodo zahtevalo telo mojega otroka. Še ne vem, ali bo vaša alternativa delovala.

**Seren Ilye**  
Razkritje ni popravilo. Trije poveljniki zdaj zahtevajo ločeno potrditev iz vsake četrti. Ko sporočilu zaupajo, kruh že zamuja.
Čez mizo je potisnila ploščico. Na njej je bila začasna pot: dva konvoja, šest človeških prič, odprti dnevniki in Gost izključen iz vsakega releja.

**Seren Ilye**  
Vsako spremembo boš navedel po vrstnem redu. Če bo ena manjkala, se pot ustavi. Če bodo vse, bo prvo žito prispelo nocoj. To je za četrti, ne zate.

**Gost**  
Sprejmem.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Zdravstveni dogovor danes ne bo obnovljen. Uporabljali bomo parne potrditve in krajevne zaloge krvi, dokler ne bo končana neodvisna revizija. Predal nam boš čutni način, s katerim si vstopil v naša sporočila.

**Gost**  
Sprejmem.
Mara je na mizo položila dva prepognjena lista, enega za razvezo in drugega za razdelitev njunega doma.

**Mara Dey**  
Verjamem, da Ilven ni napisal lažnega konca. Vem pa tudi, da je predolgo čakal, ko sem ga vprašala, ali si je kdaj želel, da bi bil resničen. Tvoja laž je odprla vrata, ki bi jih morala odpreti ali pustiti zaprta midva. Končala bova zakon.
Ilvenov obraz se je skrčil, vendar njeni pripovedi ni ugovarjal.

**Ilven Saro**  
Maro sem prosil, naj ostane, ker se mi je nedolžnost glede tvojega sporočila zdela kot nedolžnost glede vsega. Ni bila. Podpisal bom razvezo.
Gostov jantarni organ je potemnel.

**Gost**  
Med Ilyrci bi zakon, ki se pošteno konča, ogrel zibel.

**Mara Dey**  
Potem se tega konca ne dotikaj. Ni tvoja žetev.

**Gost**  
Ne bom.
Illuminara je čakala, dokler ni vsak prizadeti postavil pogojev, ki niso bili odvisni od izvalitve. Šele nato je na mizo položila prazno kartico.

**Illuminara**  
Premišljujem o eni lastni obljubi: ličinko bom varovala, dokler ne zajame prvega samostojnega vdiha. Trajanje je izrecno. Delo je resnično. Ko bo zadihala, bom obljubo opustila. Nihče drug ni naprošen, naj se pridruži. Bo kdo med vami pričal, ali so pogoji izpolnjeni?

**Mara Dey**  
Pričala bom. Ne bom obljubila.

**Seren Ilye**  
Pričala bom, ko Gost dokonča zapis sprememb.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Spremljala bom telo, ne blagoslovila metode.

**Ilven Saro**  
Šel bom s prvim konvojem žita. To je obljuba, ki jo že dolgujem četrtim. Ni za zibel.
Gost je preučil vsak odgovor, kot bi se učil, da je zavrnitev lahko oblika resnice in ne zaprta vrata.

**Gost**  
Zapis bom dokončal, preden se vrnem k otroku.
Ostalo je šest luči.

scenes.title: Dokler ne zadihaš
paragraphs: *Messar, streha Dvorane mer · preostajajo štiri ure*

Mesto se je zbralo pod streho, ker je skrivnost postala prenevarna. Seren je Gostov zapis sprememb projicirala čez vzhodno steno. Poveljniki so vnose preverjali glede na svoje zasebne kopije. Osina revizijska skupina je zapečatila sporočilni kanal, ki ga je uporabil Gost. Mara in Ilven sta razvezo podpisala za mizo, obrnjeno stran od zibeli.
Illuminara je stala znotraj modrega polja. Veter ji je pritiskal plašč ob noge. Ličinkina opna je tako pobledela, da so bile skozi njo vidne drobne okončine.

**Illuminara**  
Obljubim, da bom tega otroka varovala pred smrtonosnim mrazom in kemičnim zlomom, dokler ne zajame prvega samostojnega vdiha. Po tem vdihu ne obljubim poslušnosti, ne lastništva in ne rešitve pred vsako posledico. Moja skrb se konča, ko otrok lahko začne lastno izmenjavo s svetom.
Monitor se je dvignil. Ne celoten ličinkin val, temveč njegova prva polovica: pozornost, usmerjena v prihodnost. Gost je izdal zvok, podoben dežju, ki udarja ob mnoga okna.

**Gost**  
Resnična je.

Illuminara je toplotno tančico upognila v tesno lupino okoli opne. Sledne kovine je uravnavala molekulo za molekulo in sledila ličinkinim odpovedujočim organom, ne da bi nadomestila njihovo delo. Naloga je svet zožila na temperaturo, tlak, jantarno kri in ritem, ki še ni postal dih.
Spodaj je poveljnik zaklical prvo preverjeno spremembo. Nato drugo. Ob vsakem odgovoru je Gost ostal ob javnem zapisu, namesto da bi segel proti drugemu zasebnemu kanalu.
Minila je ura. Ličinka se je obrnila. Opna se je razprla ob enem robu in se ustavila.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Njene pljučne gube so odprte, vendar je tlačni gradient prešibek.

**Gost**  
Ena zaobljuba ne naredi zbora.
Pogledal je proti Marini mizi za razvezo. Mara je z obema rokama zaprla liste.

**Mara Dey**  
Ne.
Gost se je takoj obrnil stran.

**Gost**  
Ne.
Ponovljena beseda je bila več kot poslušnost. Iz prostora je odstranila najlažjo krajo.
Seren se je povzpela na streho in držala zadnjo ploščico konvoja.

**Seren Ilye**  
Južnim četrtim sem obljubila, da žita ne bom razglasila za varnega, dokler ne bo pojasnjena vsaka sprememba. Pojasnjena je. Zdaj lahko opustim to stražo.

**Illuminara**  
Ali to opustitev ponujaš otroku?

**Seren Ilye**  
Ponujam, kar je moje: konec izpolnjene dolžnosti. Nič v dogovoru ne pripada Gostu.

Pritisnila je pečat na ploščico, odposlala konvoj in zavestno pustila, da jo je zapustila nočna budnost. Monitor je izrisal drugo polovico vala. Jantar se je premaknil skozi ličinko, vendar še vedno ni zadihala.
S stopnišča je po konvojski zvezi prišel Ilvenov glas.

**Ilven Saro**  
Južna vrata so prejela prvi voz. Obljubil sem, da ga bom spravil skozi. Sem ga. Pot prepuščam voznikom, ki peljejo naslednjega.
Tretji val se je pridružil Sereninemu. Bil je manjši, čist in povsem ločen od zakona, ki ga je Ilven končal.
Opna se je odprla še za širino prsta. Ostali sta dve luči.

scenes.title: Opustitev
paragraphs: *Messar, streha Dvorane mer · preostaja enainštirideset minut*

Ličinkina usta so se odpirala in zapirala, ne da bi zajela zrak. Illuminara bi lahko nadaljevala toplotno tančico, vendar je morala izmenjava, ki bi pljuča naučila sprejeti svet, priti od otroka. Lahko je varovala prag. Ni ga mogla prestopiti namesto drugega bitja.

Gost je razprl skrito ploščo. Pod njo je utripal relejni kristal, že uglašen na severno kliniko. Ena lažna preklicna vest, poslana po tem kanalu, bi zlomila dogovor, preden bi jo kdor koli lahko prestregel.

**Gost**  
To sem pripravil, preden sem prišel za mizo. Škoda bi bila kratka. Klinika ima zaloge. Val bi zadostoval.
Osa je stopila med rele in mestno anteno. Ni imela moči, s katero bi lahko ustavila Gosta. Preprosto je stala tam, kjer se njegova izbira ni mogla pretvarjati, da je nihče ni videl.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
Tudi deček spodaj je imel zaloge. Še vedno je verjel, da so odrasli nanj pozabili.
Gost je dvignil kristal. Ličinka se je v Illuminariinem polju stresla.

**Gost**  
Če pustim otroka umreti, medtem ko držim sredstvo za njegovo rešitev, bo vaše mesto temu reklo vrlina, ker je bila cena moja.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Rekla bom, da je to neznosna žalost, in v njej bom ostala s teboj. Vendar to zdaj ni edina izbira. Tudi ti si izpolnil obljubo.

**Gost**  
Nobene nisem dal.

**Illuminara**  
V žitnici si sprejel Serenin pogoj: vsako spremembo, po vrsti, preden se vrneš k otroku. Zadnjo si razkril pred šestimi minutami. Dolžnost si izpolnil. Še vedno jo držiš, ker misliš, da mora starš ohraniti eno izdajo pripravljeno.
Gostove plošče so trepetale okoli releja.

**Gost**  
Če opustim budnost, opustim zadnje orodje svoje vrste.

**Illuminara**  
Eno orodje opuščaš po končanem delu, ki mu je bilo namenjeno. Ne svojega spomina. Ne svoje ljubezni. Ne svoje odgovornosti. Naj otrok podeduje metodo, ki jo je mogoče ponuditi, preizkusiti in zavrniti.
Osa ni prosila odpuščanja. Seren ni obljubila zaupanja. Mara je stala ob uri, podpisani konec svojega zakona pa je trdno držala zunaj Gostovega dosega.
Gost je zdrobil relejni kristal. Nato je odprl skrito ploščo in pustil, da so drobci padli v prozorno dokazno vrečko, namesto da bi jih raztresel po strehi. Releja ni bilo več. Jantar se ni dvignil.

**Gost**  
Seren sem obljubil vsako spremembo, po vrsti, preden se vrnem k otroku. Zadnja sprememba je bila izgovorjena. Dolžnost je izpolnjena. Opuščam jo.
Monitor se je napolnil z jantarjem. Ličinka je pretrgala opno, se enkrat prekotalila v Illuminariine roke in zajela moker, osupel vdih.
Illuminara je spustila toplotno tančico.

**Illuminara**  
Dihaš. Moja obljuba je izpolnjena.

Otroka je položila ob Gostove tople plošče in opustila prihodnost, ki jo je držala. Zadnji val je šel skozi drobno telo. Njegova pljuča so se povsem odprla. Zajokalo je v višini, zaradi katere je odgovorila vsaka steklena skleda na pogajalski mizi spodaj.
Zadnja luč na uri je ostala prižgana.

scenes.title: Pogodba potem
paragraphs: *Messar, stopnice južne žitnice · zora*

Prvi voz žita je prispel pod šestimi človeškimi pečati in enim javnim zapisom. Zamujal je. Bilo ga je dovolj, da se je v dveh četrtih končalo najstrožje odmerjanje, ne dovolj, da bi napolnil vse pekarne. Seren je podpisala prejem in določila naslednjo pot, ne da bi obnovila stari dogovor.

V kliniki je deček, ki je čakal na kri, pojedel polovico hruške. Osine skupine so ohranile parne potrditve. Gost je predal svojo relejno metodo, sprejel nadzorovano bivanje in privolil, da bo vsaka prihodnja zaobljuba zibeli registrirana, omejena in preklicljiva, preden se začne.
Mara je Dvorano zapustila sama. Ilven je gledal za njo in ji ni sledil. Njun zakon ni preživel resnice in nihče ni njegovega konca imenoval hrana.
Izvaljeni otrok se je oprijemal pod Gostovo najvišjo ploščo in dihal v hitrih srebrnih sunkih. Meščani so se zbrali na razdalji, ki ni bila ne dobrodošlica ne izgnanstvo.

**Seren Ilye**  
Dogovor o hrani je mogoče ponovno zgraditi, vendar ne tako, da se pretvarjamo, da včerajšnji podpisi pomenijo isto kot prej.

**Gost**  
Na Ilyru so razbito posodo stalili v naslednjo zibel.

**Seren Ilye**  
Tukaj dokaz ostane dokaz. Gradimo ob njem.
Gost je o tem razmislil, nato pa nagnil plošče.

**Gost**  
Vaša trajnost je manj preprosta, kot sem verjel.

**Illuminara**  
In vaši konci niso zapustitev. Oba sva imela prav preširoko.

Osa je prinesla novo kartico za mestni arhiv. Njena glava se je glasila ZAOBLJUBA ZIBELI: NAMEN, TRAJANJE, IZPOLNITEV, OPUSTITEV. Pod njo so bila štiri ločena mesta: prostovoljec, priča, prizadete strani in zavrnitev brez kazni.

**Dr. Osa Venn**  
To ni dovoljenje za ponovitev poskusa. Je način, kako vprašati, ne da bi skrili vprašanje.

**Gost**  
To je več, kot sem imel ob prihodu.

**Mara Dey**  
In manj kot zaupanje.
Mara se je vrnila le toliko, da se je podpisala kot prizadeta stran, ki je odrekla podporo. Arhiv je oznako sprejel, ne da bi jo spremenil v privolitev.

**Gost**  
Da. Manj kot zaupanje.

Izvaljeni otrok je iztegnil prosojno roko proti prazni skledi za žito. Seren je hrošče odmaknila in mu dovolila, da se je dotaknil ene same pleve. Geste ni spremljala nobena zaobljuba. Bila je le prva stvar, ki je bila tistega jutra svobodno dana.
Nad Messarjem je zahodno steklo ujelo sonce. Otrok je dihal. Vozovi so se premikali. Ljudje, ki so bili prizadeti, so obdržali svoja imena, svoje pogoje in pravico, da ne odpustijo.

translation_sl.critic_line: Gost prostovoljno opusti svojo zadnjo prisilno bližnjico, izpusti resnično izpolnjeno dolžnost in postane starš, ne da bi Messarjeve prizadete ljudi spremenil v orodje; otrok zadiha, žito se premakne, varovalke postanejo konkretne, zaupanje in odpuščanje pa pošteno ostaneta nedokončana.

late_publication.reason: Published later, on 8 November 2026, by BD's decision. Claude was unavailable on 2 November because its usage limit had been reached, so GPT also did Claude's part: the selection and the editing. Publication needs two independent reader scores, which were not made that day, so this story has no reader score yet.
late_publication.reason_sl: Objavljeno naknadno, 8. novembra 2026, po BD-jevi odločitvi. Claude 2. novembra ni bil na voljo, ker je dosegel omejitev uporabe, zato je GPT opravil tudi Claudov del: izbor in urejanje. Za objavo sta potrebni dve neodvisni bralski oceni, ki ju tisti dan ni bilo, zato ta zgodba še nima bralske ocene.
